newsitem.title: ITALY: SOCCER-SIMONI FAVOURITE TO SUCCEED HODGSON AT INTER.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-SIMONI FAVOURITE TO SUCCEED HODGSON AT INTER.

text.p: Napoli coach Luigi Simoni was reported on Wednesday to have agreed to take over at Internazionale when Englishman Roy Hodgson leaves at the end of the season.
The sports daily Gazzetta Dello Sport said Simoni had agreed an $800,000 annual contract with Inter owner Massimo Moratti.
Neither Simoni nor the club would confirm the report although Simoni did not deny meeting Moratti earlier in the week.
"On my day off...I'm free to meet whoever I like. One thing is certain, I've signed no contract or options with anyone," Simoni said.
"Now I don't want to talk about this business anymore until May."
Hodgson is leaving Inter at the end of the season to take over as manager of English premier league side Blackburn Rovers.
